name: Cyverfunk
storyline:
Reclaim the dance floor !!

Vampires and wolves are now part of Cyberpunk society, even though their rivalry continues like in the old days. Technology has evolved so much that it's not worth getting into a physical fight, instead they fight on the dancefloor.

Our main character Veronica never had the chance to try this new way of fighting. Until a group of wolves decided that the dance hall, which she had been going to since she was a child, was now their territory.
